FAQ.sectionDescription: Common questions from students about MERN stack, live classes, projects, payment, and course access.

FAQ.question: I'm a complete beginner. Is this course for me?
FAQ.answer: Absolutely! The course is structured from beginner to advanced level, covering fundamentals of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, up to complex MERN stack production workflows.

FAQ.question: What happens if I miss a live class?
FAQ.answer: You will get lifetime access to full HD recorded sessions of every live class on your dashboard.

FAQ.question: What software or tools will I need?
FAQ.answer: We will use free industry-standard tools like VS Code, Node.js, Git, and MongoDB. Complete setup guidance will be provided in Class 1.

FAQ.question: How can I complete the payment?
FAQ.answer: You can pay using bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfers, or Credit/Debit Cards. EMI option is also available.

FAQ.question: Can I start job hunting or freelancing after this course?
FAQ.answer: Yes, you will build 6+ industry-level projects that can be featured directly in your portfolio to target local or remote tech jobs and freelancing.

FAQ.question: How does the money-back guarantee work?
FAQ.answer: If you are not satisfied within 7 days of enrollment, you can claim a 100% refund with no questions asked.
